snippet.title: 『Pain Pain Go Away!』Introduction Movie【INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25】
snippet.description:
▼Click here for the Steam store page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3127750/Pain_Pain_Go_Away/

▼Click here for the Official X
https://x.com/Lorebard_info

Pain Pain Go Away! launches on Steam on May 20, 2026. A demo is also available now, so be sure to check it out.
This is a typing adventure game where you type away the trauma hidden deep in people’s hearts.
Players dive into the minds of patients and use typing to calm the emotions causing them pain. 
It is not just about typing quickly — the game also includes mystery-solving elements, requiring you to use deduction to uncover the secrets buried in their hearts.
Why have these girls shut themselves away?
Use typing and investigation to heal the darkness within them.
